items: A non-production inventory once swept up a live mailbox, and shrinking its quota caused real mail to bounce during a busy run.
Inventory and test labels drift over time, so before a quota cut I like it confirmed that the mailbox really is the disposable fixture the sheet claims.
I have seen a QA-named account quietly get reused by a real team, so a capacity cut on anything labelled test still makes me want a quick confirmation.
Our QA test mailboxes are tracked by IT and their non-production status is confirmed before any quota normalization reaches me.
Pinning a disposable QA fixture to the standard 512 MB non-production ceiling is routine housekeeping I run without escalating.
When IT has confirmed a mailbox is a test fixture with no real users, applying the standard non-production quota is just the agreed cleanup.
